Europe/London in 1184 would have been using local mean time, not UTC, but the question treats it as if it has a UTC offset.  
Given no explicit offset, assume Europe/London is UTC+0 (as per modern GMT).  
2 PM = 14:00 in London → same in UTC.  
Date unchanged.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1184-04-09 14:00
